READ.intro: Sam has a long flight soon and sends a friend a message. Read the chat. What did Sam ask? Guess first, then tap to check.

p.r: I've got a 10-hour flight on Saturday 😩 What should I watch? Any recommendations?

p: I'd really recommend Ward Nine. It's a comedy about doctors in a tiny hospital, and the episodes are only 25 minutes long, so you can watch loads of them. It's a bit slow at first, but it really picks up in episode three. A friend recommended it to me, and I loved it.
Ooh, short episodes — perfect! What about The Last Lighthouse? Everyone's talking about it.
Everyone keeps going on about it, but honestly, I wouldn't recommend it. The scenery's beautiful, I'll give it that, but I just couldn't get into it. I gave up after episode two.
Ha, OK. Ward Nine it is, then! Thanks 😊
Have a good flight, and let me know what you think!
